review_type: Internal independent AI-assisted review; not qualified external biological or legal review.
scope: Exact 12-file conditional weighting and recent-primary-source package. Integrated repository, immutable commit, merge and live publication verification are separate.

mathematical_review.independent_proof: Derived odds bounds from mean multiplicities in [1,K], finite count bounds from reachable clone totals, and uniform supremum by optimizing the extreme-weight gap.
mathematical_review.oracle: Independent reachable-state convolution, developed without importing candidate arithmetic.
mathematical_review.K3_gap: 2-sqrt(3), approximately 0.2679491924311227; sharp supremum, unattained by a finite integer population.
mathematical_review.finite_sharpness: Exact pointwise endpoints conditional only on N,k,K and optional J; further identities/ties can tighten and simultaneous threshold attainment is not asserted.

conditions: Unchanged inspected generating pipeline, with no added duplication or undocumented loss.
Stable one-to-one clone identities, finite per-run fits and common exported clone mean.
One to three retained rows per eligible clone in run2/run3/run4; nonempty selected population.
Identical ancestor and positive-mean selectors in both CDFs.
not_established: Actual row multiplicities or clone counts
Identity of deposited tables with inspected source execution
All mutation births, native W/A/M panel, new theorem, confidence interval, or biological fit

figure_review.visual_inspection: PASS; readable mathematical curves, explicit hypothetical label and conditional Lauer scope, no empirical points.

key_limits: 652 lines established/sequenced, followed by seven contamination exclusions and one outlier exclusion.
Growth proxy and generation denominator depend on an exponential-growth measurement model.
Per-hour SNV/indel nonsignificance does not establish independence.
LOH addback estimates expected lost mutations; it does not observe all births.
Source-reported controls were not numerically replayed; causal mechanisms and generality remain unresolved.
The paper fitness symbol is not the native TMD Wsp route.

rights_privacy_and_budget.CSV_download_gate: Unchanged and parked; no download-host retry.

preservation_scope: Actual baseline independently verified at 893 tracked files, 349 matching checkpoint fingerprints, 26 study NULLs, 18 planning NULLs, zero native panels and methods 0.6.0. Integrated candidate preservation checked separately.
